extraction.policy_summary: Bank of Maharashtra states it 'has adopted an Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities to promote inclusion and non-discrimination,' with the policy available on the Bank's website at https://bankofmaharashtra.bank.in/policies. The Bank also states it is 'committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion' and 'continues to take appropriate measures to ensure that all employees are provided with an enabling work environment and equitable access to opportunities.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As at end of FY 2025-26, the Bank reports 407 total differently abled employees (328 male, approx. 80.6%; 79 female, approx. 19.4%), all under the employees category, and 0 total differently abled workers, out of a total workforce of 15,601 employees.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The Bank answers 'Yes' that its premises/offices are easily accessible to differently abled employees per the RPwD Act, 2016, and separately states 'Banks premises of head office, zonal offices are conveniently accessible for person with disability.' No specific physical features (ramps, restrooms, elevators, etc.) are itemized.
extraction.compliance_details: The Bank affirmatively answers the mandated BRSR statutory questions: premises/offices accessible to differently abled employees per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ('Yes'); an Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities is in place with a web-link provided; and premises of head office and zonal offices are accessible to differently abled visitors ('Yes').

evidence.quote: Bank of Maharashtra has adopted an Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities to promote inclusion and non-discrimination. The policy is available on the Bank's website at: https://bankofmaharashtra.bank.in/policies
Yes, the premises/offices of the Bank are easily accessible to differently abled employees as per the requirements of the rights of person with disabilities Act 2016.
Yes, Banks premises of head office, zonal offices are conveniently accessible for person with disability.
